open_questions: QA-analyst: the bot's _buy_wanted needs cash >= fixed_cost + price before it turns a Buy on; that rule, not the game, made decent seed 7 idle. Loosen it to price only (the engine already protects the reserve)?
handoff: Seed 7 idle: only Sell orders (4 flags, no Buy). The bot's own Buy rule (cash >= trip + price, with fixed_cost for one route) kept every Buy off at cash 104. Not a real-player softlock: route_reserve already gives 0 for routes with no stock and no feeding Buy, so an empty Sell order holds no cash; one Buy click with cash above one unit buys. No game code changed. Test added.

details.cause: Replay on the current tree (data_version 25 plus uncommitted tuning) no longer idles in seeds 1-8 (decent), so the exact round-2 state could not be dumped. From the bot code: _apply_orders adds a Buy only when _buy_wanted is true (stock < units and cash >= fixed_cost + price); Sell is always on at lane ends. issue text counts buy+sell flags, 4 flags with 4 routes = 4 Sell orders. Round 2 cash stayed 104 from cycle 15.
details.real_player: No. Reserve skips routes with no stock and no feeding Buy (route_engine.route_reserve), so cash 104 is not held. A Buy at the source needs only afford >= one unit price (after reserve 0). Manual trade also works. Only stuck if cash is below the cheapest unit price, which is a loss-state rather than a bug.
details.fix: none in game code; reserve protection and forecast==settle unchanged
details.test: tools/tests/run_tests.gd _test_sell_only_idle: 6 checks (empty Sell holds no reserve, nothing moves with forecast==settle, one Buy at cash trip+price-1 or less moves stock, forecast==settle).
